description: Bounded sparse symmetric Gauss-Seidel sweep over explicit graph-color classes.

input.encoding: [n, nnz, color_count, order[n], color_offsets[color_count+1], rowptr[n+1], colind[nnz], values[nnz], x0[n], b[n]]
input.matrix_semantics: exactly symmetric, strictly row-diagonally-dominant CSR matrix with one positive diagonal per row
input.color_semantics: order is a permutation, offsets define nonempty contiguous classes, and no off-diagonal CSR edge has endpoints in one class

output.encoding: n final x values after one forward and one backward color-class sweep

contract.operation: For each color class in ascending order, then descending order, update each row in its supplied class order using its stored CSR order. Accumulate off-diagonal x[column]*value terms left-to-right and assign (b[row]-sum)/diagonal.
contract.numeric_profile: binary64 projection of the pinned default binary32 ValueT recurrence
contract.source_host_note: The pinned host's random matrix-weight initialization is commented out; the profile supplies matrix and vectors explicitly.

workspace.meaning: Staged final x vector at the declared maximum node count.
